quiz.question_en: Why does `UserService` accept `UserRepository` instead of `PostgresUserRepo` directly?
options_id: Agar implementasi repository bisa diganti, termasuk mock saat test
Karena struct konkret tidak bisa punya method
options_en: So the repository implementation can be swapped, including a mock during tests
Because interfaces are always faster
Because concrete structs cannot have methods
So database queries become asynchronous

quiz.question_id: Dalam structural typing Go, kapan `MockUserRepo` bisa menggantikan repository nyata?
quiz.question_en: In Go's structural typing, when can `MockUserRepo` replace the real repository?
options_id: Saat ia memiliki method set yang sama dengan interface yang dibutuhkan
options_en: Only if it is declared with `implements UserRepository`
When the struct name starts with `Mock`
When it has the same method set as the required interface
Only inside `_test.go` files

quiz.question_id: Apa keuntungan field seperti `FindByIDFunc func(id int) (*User, error)` pada mock?
quiz.question_en: What is the benefit of a field like `FindByIDFunc func(id int) (*User, error)` on the mock?
options_id: Per test kita bisa mengatur perilaku dependency secara spesifik tanpa mengubah production code
Go compiler mengisi field itu otomatis
Field function selalu lebih cepat dari method biasa
options_en: It lets each test control dependency behavior precisely without changing production code
The Go compiler fills that field automatically
It is the only way to create an interface
Function fields are always faster than normal methods

quiz.question_id: `SaveCalls []*User` pada mock terutama berguna untuk apa?
quiz.question_en: What is `SaveCalls []*User` on the mock mainly useful for?
options_id: Melacak interaction sehingga test bisa memverifikasi siapa yang disimpan dan berapa kali
options_en: Storing backup database connections
Tracking interactions so tests can verify what was saved and how many times
Caching every production user
Avoiding the need for interfaces

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `fmt.Errorf` dengan `%w` lebih kuat daripada hanya mencetak error biasa?
quiz.question_en: Why is `fmt.Errorf` with `%w` stronger than simply printing the error value?
options_id: Karena `%w` menambah konteks sambil tetap membungkus error asli untuk di-unwrapping
Karena `%w` menghapus error asli dari chain
Karena `%w` otomatis mengubah error jadi HTTP response
options_en: Because `%w` adds context while still wrapping the original error for unwrapping
Because `%w` removes the original error from the chain
Because `%w` automatically turns the error into an HTTP response
Because `%w` makes the function panic

quiz.question_id: Dependency mana yang paling tepat dimock menurut lesson?
quiz.question_en: Which dependency is the most appropriate to mock according to the lesson?
options_id: Repository atau service eksternal yang membuat test tidak terisolasi
options_en: A simple data struct like `User`
A repository or external service that would make the test non-isolated
Literal values like `int` and `string`
The `testing` package itself

quiz.question_id: Apa kualitas unit test yang biasanya meningkat saat memakai mock dibanding DB nyata?
quiz.question_en: What unit test qualities usually improve when using a mock instead of a real database?
options_id: Test menjadi lebih deterministik, cepat, dan tidak tergantung infrastruktur eksternal
Test selalu mencakup lebih banyak integrasi
Error handling production jadi tidak penting
options_en: Tests become more deterministic, faster, and independent of external infrastructure
Tests always cover more integrations
Tests no longer need assertions
Production error handling stops mattering

quiz.question_id: Cara injeksi dependency yang paling sesuai agar mudah di-mock adalah...
quiz.question_en: What is the most appropriate way to inject a dependency so it is easy to mock?
options_id: Membuat `PostgresUserRepo` langsung di dalam method service
Menerima interface sebagai field struct atau parameter konstruktor
Menggunakan `reflect` untuk menukar implementasi saat runtime
options_en: Constructing `PostgresUserRepo` directly inside the service method
Storing the repository in a global variable
Accepting an interface as a struct field or constructor parameter
Using `reflect` to swap the implementation at runtime

quiz.question_id: Jika `MockUserRepo.FindByIDFunc` bernilai `nil` pada kode lesson, method `FindByID` mock akan...
quiz.question_en: If `MockUserRepo.FindByIDFunc` is `nil` in the lesson's code, what will the mock's `FindByID` method do?
options_en: panic because the function field is empty
return `nil, nil`
return a default user with ID 0
automatically call the production repository

quiz.question_id: Jenis assertion apa yang dimungkinkan oleh mock dengan call tracking, tetapi sulit dilakukan jika hanya memeriksa return value?
quiz.question_en: What kind of assertion becomes possible with a mock that tracks calls, but is difficult if you only inspect return values?
options_id: Memverifikasi bahwa `Save` dipanggil dengan argumen yang diharapkan
options_en: Verifying that `Save` was called with the expected argument
Confirming the Go compiler is the latest version
Measuring benchmark allocations
Checking editor syntax highlighting
